extension.description: Generate Conventional Commit messages from staged changes using cloud or local LLM providers.
command.generateMessage.title: AI Commit: Generate Commit Message
configuration.title: AI Commit Assistant
configuration.provider.title: Provider
configuration.provider.description: AI provider used to generate commit messages.
configuration.baseUrl.title: Base URL
configuration.baseUrl.description: Optional API base URL. Leave empty to use the selected provider's default endpoint. Required for Azure OpenAI.
configuration.apiKey.title: API Key
configuration.apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider. Stored in machine-scoped VS Code settings, not SecretStorage, and not synchronized. Leave empty for Ollama or LM Studio unless authentication is enabled.
configuration.model.title: Model
configuration.model.description: Model ID used for generation. For Azure OpenAI, enter the deployment name.
configuration.commitLanguage.title: Commit Language
configuration.commitLanguage.description: Language used for the generated commit description. Auto follows the VS Code display language; type and scope remain in English.
